content:
deploy-bot: PROMOTION HALTED: staging-canary (tag: release-v1.12.0-canary.3) failed e2e-suite (3/3 fails). Blocking auto-promo. CI run: #4532. logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/4532 :red_circle:
maria: Ugh. Which tests? any stacktraces?
kevin: Looks like the failures are all in the `session-token-rotation` integration tests. Same stacktrace: db connection timeout + test seed mismatch.
anika: I saw flakiness earlier locally with concurrency=16. Might be test harness randomness.
maria: Could we just re-run the pipeline? If it's a flake, rerun usually clears it.
kevin: Rerun is fine but deploy-bot showed 3 consecutive failures across different runners. I'm worried about transient infra (db-side latency).
sam: We have a change window in 45m. If we wait for a rerun, we might miss it. Options: 1) Pin to last-green (release-v1.11.4) and proceed 2) Rerun and hope 3) Delay release to triage. Thoughts?
anika: If we pin, we need a quick QA smoke on prod. Pin requires changelog + revert note in release notes.
maria: Is the regression caused by anything in this release? The changelog shows only a perf tweak on KV cache. Not obviously related. But the test touches session logic.
kevin: I dug into the canary logs: one runner saw 1200ms DB connect latency spikes during setup. That's infra. I'll ping infra. @ops-bot can you check DB host pool around that time?
ops-bot: @kevin checked DB cluster: brief maintenance job at 2024-09-18T14:52Z caused pool reconnects on us-east-1 staging. Impact window matches failures.
kevin: So failures likely due to infra noise. Rerun should be safe.
sam: Given the change window, quick plan: rerun once now. If green -> promote. If still failing -> pin to v1.11.4 and document rollback steps in release notes, then schedule manual rollback investigation after cut. Agree?
maria: Fine with that. Also add note in release notes: "Cut kept on hold due to transient staging DB maintenance; pinned to previous release to avoid user impact" if we pin.
anika: I'll prepare the smoke checklist for post-pin.
kevin: Kickoff rerun: `ci retry 4532`
deploy-bot: CI run #4533 started (retry of #4532).
(20m pass)
deploy-bot: CI run #4533 completed: 5/5 e2e passed ✅. Auto-promo resuming.
sam: Nice. Proceed with canary promote. Update release notes with a brief note about the staging flake and infra maintenance.
maria: I'll add the line and include the changelog link. Tagging @anika for QA post-promote.
anika: On it — will run the smoke checklist after canary is live.
kevin: Filing a follow-up ticket to coordinate with infra to avoid maintenance during change windows: INFRA-1284.
sam: Good call. Leaving this thread open until post-promote verification.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: change-window closing in 35m.
maria: post-promote: canary looks clean, no regressions in logs. closing thread after 1h verification. Thanks everyone :tada:
